intent: A custom fallback keeps the name, provider and model id the operator typed. model_fallbacks carried only the registry FK, which a custom entry does not have; the INSERT dropped its identity and every read joined models for it and found nothing, so the POST echoed the input and the next list said Custom / custom / an empty model id, which is what the chain then pushed into config.yaml. Found on the isolated instance during C3's walk (T-0138). Migration 042 adds three columns; the repository writes them for a custom entry and reads them where the JOIN has nothing.

side_effects: schema_version 41 to 42 on the next boot, three nullable columns added, no backfill
